```yaml
name: Debug Workflow for Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Log environment details
      run: |
        echo "GitHub Actions Runner OS: $RUNNER_OS"
        echo "Node version: $(node --version)"
        echo "NPM version: $(npm --version)"

    - name: Check authentication status
      run: |
        curl -I https://api.github.com/user

    - name: Get branch protection rules
      id: get_branch_protection
      run: |
        gh api /repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/main/protection | jq .

    - name: Log branch protection rules
      run: echo "::debug::Branch Protection Rules: ${{ steps.get_branch_protection.outputs.stdout }}"

    - name: Commit changes
      uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
      with:
        add: .
        commit: "Debugging push permissions"
        committer_name: "GitHub Actions"
        committer_email: "actions@github.com"
        push: true

    - name: Report workflow status to Slack
      uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
      with:
        owner: reactivando
        slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
